The West Coast Market

Why pre-construction documentation matters here.

Seismic considerations shape every renovation project on the West Coast. Existing conditions documentation is not optional in seismic zones — it is foundational. The structural engineer's assessment depends on understanding what is actually built, not what the original drawings show. Previous seismic retrofits, undocumented structural modifications, concealed connections, and the actual condition of structural elements all affect the renovation strategy. Our conditions survey and above-ceiling capture document these conditions so the design team works from accurate information rather than assumptions.

Stringent energy and sustainability code requirements add another dimension. California's Title 24 and similar frameworks in Oregon and Washington demand accurate documentation of existing HVAC systems, lighting, insulation, and building envelope performance as part of the compliance process for renovation projects. FLIR thermal imaging documents these conditions non-invasively — identifying insulation gaps, HVAC performance anomalies, and building envelope deficiencies that must be addressed to meet code requirements.

West Coast construction costs are among the highest in the country. Skilled trade labour rates frequently exceed $150 per hour. At those rates, every prevented change order has an outsized financial impact. The cost of thorough pre-construction documentation is proportionally small relative to the construction budget it informs — and the cost of incomplete documentation is proportionally large. A single scope surprise on a West Coast renovation project can cost more than the entire documentation investment.

The Deliverable

Structured site intelligence. Every project.

Every AlturaScope site visit on the West Coast produces the same structured deliverable package — whether the project is a single office conversion in San Francisco or a multi-site retail refresh across Southern California.

Navigable Digital Twin

Matterport-based 3D model of the entire space. Remote access for the full project team. Measurements taken directly in the model.

Conditions Report

P1/P2/P3 prioritised assessment of existing conditions — structural, seismic observations, MEP, finishes, code compliance, accessibility.

Equipment & Asset Schedule

Full inventory by location, make, model, condition, and services connections. Formatted for procurement and design teams.

Thermal Imaging (FLIR)

Building envelope analysis, insulation verification, HVAC performance assessment, and hidden services identification — supporting Title 24 and energy code compliance.

Above-Ceiling MEP Documentation

Thermal, pole-mounted 360°, and borescope capture of ceiling plenum conditions, structural connections, services routing, and conflicts.

ScopeWalk Platform

All deliverables structured in a single portal. Permanent access. For multi-site programmes: compare locations side by side.

Sectors

Markets we serve on the West Coast.

QSR & Restaurant

West Coast QSR and restaurant remodel programmes operate in some of the most expensive construction markets in the country — where every change order carries a disproportionate cost. Our QSR restaurant survey programme captures the complete picture at every location in a single visit: equipment schedules, conditions reports, above-ceiling MEP documentation, and commercial kitchen detail. Complete information upfront means fewer surprises during construction — and at West Coast labour rates, that translates directly to budget saved.

Retail & Franchise

National retail refreshes and rebrands include significant West Coast portfolios — from flagship locations in Beverly Hills and Union Square to strip-mall remodels across suburban Southern California and the Pacific Northwest. Our retail rollout documentation delivers the same structured package at every store, with conditions data and equipment inventories that account for the seismic and energy code requirements specific to West Coast locations.

Healthcare

West Coast healthcare networks face the intersection of complex MEP infrastructure, seismic compliance requirements, and stringent energy codes. Capital planning programmes across multi-facility networks require documentation that captures all of these dimensions. Our healthcare facility survey methodology documents the structural, MEP, equipment, and compliance conditions that capital planning teams need to prioritise projects and allocate budget with confidence.

Commercial Renovation & Conversion

Tech sector office renovation and conversion projects. Adaptive reuse in San Francisco, Seattle, and Portland. Mixed-use development in Los Angeles. These projects depend on thorough pre-construction documentation that captures structural conditions relevant to seismic assessment, MEP infrastructure, above-ceiling routing, and building envelope performance. In markets where construction costs make every prevented change order worth thousands, the documentation investment pays for itself on the first avoided surprise.

Logistics

No local subcontractors. No variability.

AlturaScope operates under a national travel model. Every site visit on the West Coast — whether it is in downtown Los Angeles, suburban Portland, or a resort town in Hawaii — is conducted by AlturaScope using the same methodology, the same equipment, and the same deliverable standard. There is no local subcontractor lottery. Travel costs are included in all project pricing.

For programmes requiring simultaneous coverage across multiple states, we mobilise in parallel to compress your pre-construction timeline.

Common questions about West Coast site surveys.

Do you cover all West Coast states? +

Yes. We operate across every state on the West Coast — California, Oregon, Washington, Nevada, Arizona, and Hawaii. Travel is included in all project pricing. There are no per-visit travel surcharges and no local subcontractors. AlturaScope methodology, AlturaScope deliverables, every time.

How does your documentation support renovation projects in seismic zones? +

Renovation projects in seismic zones require thorough documentation of existing structural conditions — not just dimensions, but the actual condition of structural elements, connections, and any modifications made since original construction. Our conditions report documents structural observations including visible cracking, settlement, and previous retrofit work. Above-ceiling capture reveals structural connections and bracing that are concealed by finishes. This baseline documentation supports the structural engineer's seismic assessment and helps the design team understand the existing structural system before committing to a renovation strategy.

Why is pre-construction documentation especially valuable on the West Coast? +

West Coast construction costs are among the highest in the country — labour rates frequently exceed $150 per hour for skilled trades. At those rates, every prevented change order has an outsized financial impact. Thorough pre-construction documentation that captures conditions, equipment, above-ceiling infrastructure, and thermal anomalies before the design is committed reduces the scope surprises that generate the most expensive change orders. The documentation investment is proportionally small relative to the cost of the construction it informs.

Can you support multi-site programmes across the West Coast? +

Yes. We deliver the same structured documentation package at every location through ScopeWalk, coordinate scheduling centrally, and mobilise across multiple states in parallel when timelines require it. For national programmes that include West Coast locations alongside sites in other regions, we provide the same deliverable standard coast to coast — your team works from one format regardless of where the building is.
